summary: A shoulder-fired recoilless rocket launcher (RPG-style): a hollow olive launch tube with a wooden heat guard… joints sight, tube, warhead; sockets socket_muzzle, socket_sight, grip_r, grip_l, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.rocket_launcher or place "prefab": "rocket_launcher" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
